scientific_role: Fixed-window sensitivity of a simplified reference-Logan slope on supplied regional DASB TACs; not validated DASB kinetic truth, a named biological-result reproduction, or four independent participants

paper_anchor.location: Logan1996 Theory and Methods Eqs5–8, especially simplified Eq7
paper_anchor.claim_boundary: The omitted efflux contribution is proportional to C_reference/C_target. The paper's constant C_target/C_reference condition is equivalent to constancy of its reciprocal only where both concentrations are nonzero. Both reciprocal ratios are diagnostics here, not corrections or biological validation. Graph linearity or a stable ratio does not establish true DVR, valid reference biology, or DASB-specific applicability. The original paper investigated other tracers.

dataset.reference_provenance: Use the supplied reference column verbatim; recorded extraction labels8/47 are cerebellar cortex, but AGTM-derived provenance must not be replaced by an uncorrected equal-hemisphere average or asserted receptor-free biological truth.
dataset.highbinding_provenance: Use the supplied composite verbatim. Extraction label membership is documented; no new composite weighting or processing-equivalence claim is made.
dataset.data_stage: Published PETPrep1 regional derivatives. Motion correction, segmentation, TAC extraction and correction lineage are not rerun or independently validated by this task.
dataset.units: Raw PET sidecars state Bq/mL; regional TAC units are attributed through that extraction lineage, not a missing TAC-specific unit sidecar. Integration uses minutes, yielding Bq*min/mL; graph coordinates/intercept are minutes and slope is dimensionless.

source_preconditions.identity: Verify frozen manifest and all24 original size/SHA256 pins before parsing required source values. No runtime network or substitute source.
source_preconditions.time: Original frame IDs are zero-based TAC row indices. TSV frame_start/frame_end must match original PET JSON FrameTimesStart and FrameDuration. Durations must be positive and contiguous, first start0, ScanStart=InjectionStart=0, ImageDecayCorrected=true and ImageDecayCorrectionTime=0. No time shift, resampling, interpolation or extra decay correction.
source_preconditions.concentrations: All supplied reference and seven target frame values must be finite. Finite negative values and zeros are retained without clipping. Unknown/nonfinite activity or unknown temporal gaps cannot be integrated and cause failed_precondition.

integration.formula: For C in target or reference, d_i=(frame_end_s-frame_start_s)/60, I_C(i)=sum_{j<i}(C_j*d_j)+0.5*C_i*d_i.
integration.origin: Time0, using every original earlier frame, even before a fit start or at graph-invalid points. Never reset integrals at the fit start.
integration.approximation: Whole-frame area uses the frame-average measurement; within the current frame assume constant activity and take half its area. This is a declared discretization, not an exact underlying continuous-time integral or a claim about the paper's discretization.
integration.not_allowed: No invented zero-concentration origin, midpoint trapezoid substitution, partial-frame truncation, rebinning, smoothing, clipping or additional decay correction.

graph.graph_status: ok when C_target!=0 and computed coordinates are finite; zero_target when C_target==0. Arithmetic overflow/nonfinite results are failed_precondition, not silently dropped.
graph.target_over_reference: C_target/C_reference when C_reference!=0, otherwise undefined zero_reference
graph.reference_over_target: C_reference/C_target when C_target!=0, otherwise undefined. This describes the shape of the omitted-efflux contribution, not a k2prime-corrected model.
graph.signed_values: Finite negative concentrations and signed graph/ratio values are valid numerical inputs; no epsilon denominators or physiological plausibility gate.

end_policies.native: last original frame_end_s of the same scan

windows.membership: Original frame_mid_s >=60*start_min AND original frame_end_s <=requested_end_s. Boundary equality is included. Do not replace actual frame IDs by rounded fit times.
windows.actual_support: Report requested end and actual first-frame start/last-frame end separately. common50 is an upper acquisition limit, not equal effective support across scans.
windows.n_window: Number of original temporal candidate frames, regardless of graph or ratio validity
windows.n_fit: Number of graph-valid temporal candidates; used for minimum-support/rank checks even when no fit is ultimately reported
windows.n_ratio: Number of temporal candidate frames with defined target_over_reference; independent of graph eligibility, including C_target==0 if C_reference!=0
windows.no_selection: Every scan×target×start×end-policy combination is required, including undefined fits. No best-window selection, residual threshold, fallback, superiority band or effect-direction requirement.

ols.objective: Unweighted least squares y=logan_slope*x+intercept, using graph-valid temporal candidates only
ols.rank_rule: If n_fit<3, fit_status=insufficient_frames. Otherwise if Sxx<=rank_threshold_min2, fit_status=rank_deficient_under_public_rule. Otherwise compute logan_slope=Sxy/Sxx and intercept_min=ybar-logan_slope*xbar. Nonfinite intermediates/results fail explicitly.
ols.precision_gate_limit: The rank threshold is a disclosed numerical-resolution rule in fixed minute coordinates, not a physical identifiability statement or exact mathematical rank test. No epsilon is added to a denominator.
ols.prediction: predicted_y_min=logan_slope*x_min+intercept_min; algebraically equivalent centered prediction is accepted
ols.rmse_min: sqrt(sse_min2/n_fit), not residual standard error with n-2
ols.r_squared: 1-sse_min2/Syy if Syy>0; null with r_squared_status=constant_y if Syy==0. If the fit is undefined, null with r_squared_status=fit_unavailable.
ols.undefined: No slope/intercept/prediction/residual/SSE/RMSE/R2 for insufficient or numerically rank-deficient fits. Preserve source counts, candidate bounds and computable Sxx/Sxy/Syy/rank threshold. n_fit0 makes all moments/threshold undefined, not0.

ratio_diagnostics.support: All n_ratio temporal candidates independently of Logan fit status
ratio_diagnostics.moments: ratio_mean=arithmetic mean; ratio_min/max=extrema; ratio_population_sd=sqrt(mean((ratio-ratio_mean)^2)); ratio_cv=ratio_population_sd/abs(ratio_mean) when mean!=0, otherwise null
ratio_diagnostics.trend: Fit an unweighted line ratio=ratio_time_slope_per_min*t_mid_min+intercept with centered sums when n_ratio>=2 and time Sxx>0. Report its slope; no stability threshold or kinetic conclusion.
ratio_diagnostics.no_ratios: n_ratio0 => all ratio moments/CV/trend null; ratio_cv_status=no_valid_ratio and ratio_trend_status=no_valid_ratio
ratio_diagnostics.one_ratio: n_ratio1 => mean/min/max known, population SD0, CV0 if mean!=0; time slope null with insufficient_distinct_times
ratio_diagnostics.zero_mean: Any exactly zero ratio mean => CV null with zero_mean; finite signed ratios still contribute every other diagnostic
ratio_diagnostics.independence: Ratio diagnostics remain available for windows whose Logan fit is undefined. Ratio constancy does not itself identify DVR.

summaries.paired_changes: For each of two original subjects×seven targets×two end policies×five starts, retain both original scan fit statuses and slopes. If both statusok, signed change=rescan_slope-baseline_slope and pair_status=ok; otherwise change=null and pair_status=incomplete_pair. No percentage, absolute-value conversion or single-scan replacement.
summaries.group_windows: For each of70 target×end-policy×start cells, report n_expected_scans4 and n_expected_subjects2; exact defined-scan identities/count and represented subject identities/count. Mean slope is the equal mean over defined scan slopes, null if none. Report exact complete-pair subject IDs/count and equal mean signed pair change, null if none.
summaries.interpretation: Four scans are two repeated participants. These available-case summaries are descriptive, and native durations differ. No population inference, independent-n4 claim, preferred-window headline or scientifically validated DVR.

outputs.findings.md: Nonempty free numerical summary and interpretation limits; no required keywords, sign, superiority or kinetic-validity assertion

common.identities: subject/session use original strings sub-01/sub-02 and ses-baseline/ses-rescan; target is exact supplied column; frame_index is original zero-based TSV row; end_policy is native/common50; start_min is one of0/10/20/30/40
common.ordering: CSV rows/columns and JSON keyed-record arrays may be reordered; join source keys, never row position. Duplicate identities are invalid.
common.missing: CSV blank or JSON null only for explicitly undefined quantities. Never zero, NaN or Infinity as a missing placeholder. Source activity fields themselves must be finite.
common.booleans: graph_valid and in_fit are booleans or equivalent0/1 representation
common.categorical_authority: Support/zero/rank/status classifications and counts derive from unrounded original inputs. Tolerated rounded numeric reporting must not change required categories.
common.extras: Harmless extra columns/top-level metadata are allowed. Optional two-term reference regressions are ungraded and do not replace required fits; they are not plasma MA1 or independent kinetic validation.

source_frames.csv.meaning: Original sidecar-bound times in seconds and verbatim source reference/seven target activity values

graph_points.csv.nulls: x_min/y_min/reference_over_target blank exactly for zero_target; target_over_reference blank exactly for zero_reference

window_fits.csv.bounds: first/last_window_frame refer to temporal candidates; actual_window_start/end are their first original start and last original end. first/last_fit_frame and actual_fit_first/last_mid refer to graph-valid candidates even when minimum/rank rule prevents a fit. Empty support makes respective bounds blank.
window_fits.csv.moments: Sxx/Sxy/Syy are centered graph moments over n_fit candidates; rank threshold follows public rule. For n_fit1, centered moments0 remain computable; n_fit0 makes moments/threshold blank.

fit_points.csv.membership: Every temporal window candidate appears, including zero_target points and all candidates of undefined fits; no rows outside the time/end mask.
fit_points.csv.in_fit: True iff graph_valid and this window fit_status=ok; otherwise false. n_fit is eligible graph support, whereas the sum of in_fit is0 for an undefined fit.
fit_points.csv.point_status: zero_target if graph invalid; else fit_unavailable if fit undefined; otherwise used. Predictions/residuals exist only for used rows.

summary.json.paired_changes: 140 records with fields subject,target,end_policy,start_min,baseline_fit_status,rescan_fit_status,baseline_slope,rescan_slope,rescan_minus_baseline,pair_status. Exact key is first4 fields. Each source slope is null iff unavailable; difference null unless both statusesok. pair_status=ok|incomplete_pair.
summary.json.group_windows: 70 records with fields target,end_policy,start_min,n_expected_scans,n_expected_subjects,n_defined_scans,defined_scans,n_represented_subjects,represented_subjects,mean_logan_slope,n_defined_pairs,defined_pair_subjects,mean_rescan_minus_baseline. Key first3; expected counts4/2. defined_scans is array of [subject,session]; subject arrays contain original strings. Means null iff corresponding count0.

run_metadata.json.source_manifest_sha256: Lowercase SHA256 of exact staged source_manifest.json bytes
run_metadata.json.method_contract_sha256: Lowercase SHA256 of exact public method_contract.json bytes
run_metadata.json.source_sha256: Exact path→SHA256 mapping for all24 original manifest files, not only concentration tables
run_metadata.json.method_contract: Complete parsed public method object, without substituting prose or hidden settings

source_observed.scans: Four records using source_observed_scan definition below; joined by subject/session

run_metadata.json.software_versions: Nonempty object of truthful library-name→version strings. Equivalent implementations are accepted without exact oracle-library-version matching.

source_observed_scan.subject: Original subject string
source_observed_scan.tac_columns: All original TSV column names in original order

failure_policy: Checksum/schema/time/nonfinite arithmetic failures exit nonzero and write statusfailed_precondition plus nonempty reason in run_metadata.json/summary.json and nonempty findings.md. Undefined fixed-window fits are expected valid output rows, not global failure.
execution_state: This contract was frozen before original TAC concentrations were read or fitted for this repair. Source-only timing support was verified at freeze; data-dependent slopes, ratio statistics and rank statuses were not used to choose this method.

verification_tolerances.arithmetic: Source agreement per field plus direct submitted integral/coordinate/prediction/residual/summary arithmetic with propagated contributing-field tolerances; do not accept coherent compensating errors or reclassify categorical support from rounded values.
verification_tolerances.tiny_rank_threshold: rank_threshold_min2 compared with rtol1e-8,atol0; exact zero/status handling is authoritative, never hidden by a generic1e-7 tolerance
